longDescription: This is a chiptune tracker compatible with DefleMask modules (.dmf). It supports the following systems: - Sega Genesis - Sega Master System - Game Boy - PC Engine - NES - Commodore 64 - Yamaha YM2151 (plus PCM) - Neo Geo - AY-3-8910 (ZX Spectrum, Atari ST, etc.) - Microchip AY8930 - Philips SAA1099 - Amiga - TIA (Atari 2600/7800)
